glossary.specification repository: the private repository Ultra-Brain-Legacy (specifications and judgment records)
glossary.Owner: the individual user who makes the final decisions for this project
glossary.guard: the main repository's own check layer that judges each development act
glossary.command log reader: the part of the guard that reads which shell and git commands an act ran
glossary.seal: a guard state that only the Owner may lift
glossary.Green: the guard's verdict level for an act with no risk signal; such an act passes
glossary.slot: a required field of an act, such as its target or its reason
glossary.designated core: a fixed set of 191 tests inside the full regression that must all pass
glossary.native test directory: the main repository's own unit tests of its native and guard layer, not among the 6,888

builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (technical lead); the Opus judgments are not independent of the author

stopped.what: the rewrite of the command log reader
stopped.rule: a step that fails twice in a row is stopped and recorded
stopped.existing_reader: unchanged; the judges' gaps stay open, recorded privately with reproductions

landed: Green judgment: plain ASCII slot text answered without per-character Unicode lookups, the same answers
slot texts must be plain text values (a crafted text object passed an empty target and reason before)
three internal definitions nothing read were removed; unused public names were kept by the repository's rule

bench.native_engine_round_trip: not run: Windows Smart App Control blocked this build's engine image; a second image of the same source is not tried again

runs.note: one known race of the harness's own process-kill guard; the test passed 3 of 3 alone

disk.deleted: two folders of Python byte-code caches only
disk.builder_breach: the builder's early size measurement read sensitive-looking files and recorded size and SHA-256 only (no content printed or sent); deleting that record is an Owner decision
